description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer command-region checkpoint: safe Rust owns OSC 133 prompt/command/output boundary state, command capture across presentation controls and wrapped rows, scrollbar mark placement, and prompt/command/output extents.

entries.notes: CommandRegionState owns OSC 133 A/B/C/D region transitions, prompt-row scrollbar metadata, completed plus active command enumeration, and command text capture that excludes presentation-only controls such as the Microsoft SGR-in-command vector.
The same owner tracks a 100-character command across physical row wrapping while keeping scrollbar metadata only on the original prompt row and preserving the logical command as one value.

The direct witness reproduces the Microsoft PWSH C:\Windows prompt, Foo-bar command and three output rows, asserting cursor (17,4), two prompt marks, first extent start/end (0,0)/(17,0), commandEnd (24,0), outputEnd (22,3), and an open second prompt with no command/output end.
